name: Shalmaneser
bio: Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, marched against Hoshea, king of Israel, who became his vassal and paid him tribute. When Shalmaneser discovered Hoshea had conspired against him by appealing to So, king of Egypt, and withholding tribute, he imprisoned Hoshea and besieged Samaria for three years. In the ninth year of the siege, Assyria captured Samaria and deported Israel to Assyria, settling them in Halah, Habor by the river Gozan, and the cities of the Medes — ending the northern kingdom of Israel (2 Kings 17:3-6).
